description: Let the legacy two-object parser accept the natural six-word SEND actor AFTER actor WITH weapon surface by preserving the actor and target noun clauses and discarding only the refused weapon qualifier before ordinary syntax resolution

replacements.new:
<SETG P-LEN <GETB ,P-LEXV ,P-LEXWORDS>>
	<COND (<AND <EQUAL? ,P-LEN 6>
		    <EQUAL? <GET ,P-LEXV ,P-LEXSTART> ,W?SEND>
		    <EQUAL? <GET ,P-LEXV <+ ,P-LEXSTART <* 2 ,P-LEXELEN>>> ,W?AFTER>
		    <EQUAL? <GET ,P-LEXV <+ ,P-LEXSTART <* 4 ,P-LEXELEN>>> ,W?WITH>>
		   <SETG P-LEN 4>
		   <PUTB ,P-LEXV ,P-LEXWORDS 4>)>
	<COND (<ZERO? ,P-LEN> <TELL "I beg your pardon?" CR> <RFALSE>)>
